transcript: Speaker A: डॉक्टर साहब, पेशेंट आया है एम्बुलेंस से। [Doctor, a patient has arrived by ambulance.] Speaker B: हैंडओवर दो। [Give the handover.] Speaker C: सर, आदमी को छाती में दर्द था, हम लेके आए। [Sir, the man had chest pain, we brought him.] Speaker B: ये हैंडओवर है? छाती में दर्द? मेल पेशेंट, ऐज अप्रोक्सिमेट 55, प्रेजेंटिंग विद एक्यूट चेस्ट पेन। ये बोलते हैं हैंडओवर में। तुम लोग सिर्फ गाड़ी चलाना जानते हो, मेडिकल कुछ आता नहीं। [Is this a handover? Chest pain? Male patient, age approximate 55, presenting with acute chest pain. This is what you say in a handover. You people only know how to drive, you don't know anything medical.] Speaker C: सर, हम फर्स्ट एड भी किया। [Sir, we also did first aid.] Speaker B: फर्स्ट एड क्या किया? बोलो इंग्लिश में। पेशेंट हिस्ट्री लो तो इंग्लिश में लिखो। एम्बुलेंस लोग ऐसे ही रहेंगे गाड़ी चलाने वाले। [What first aid did you do? Say it in English. Take patient history in English. Ambulance people will always just be drivers.] Speaker C: सर, मे आई से समथिंग? बोल। Sir, the patient is a 55-year-old male. He presented with acute chest pain radiating to the left arm. Onset was approximately 40 minutes ago. He has a history of hypertension, no known allergies. We administered oxygen at 4 liters per minute and positioned him at 45 degrees during transit. BP at the time of pickup was 90/60, current SpO2 is 94%. [Sir, may I say something? Speak. Sir, the patient is a 55-year-old male. He presented with acute chest pain radiating to the left arm. Onset was approximately 40 minutes ago. He has a history of hypertension, no known allergies. We administered oxygen at 4 liters per minute and positioned him at 45 degrees during transit. BP at the time of pickup was 90/60, current SpO2 is 94%.] Speaker B: राजू, तूने ये कब सीखा? [Raju, when did you learn this?] Speaker C: सर, तीन महीने पहले आपने मुझे सबके सामने बोला था, एम्बुलेंस लोग सिर्फ गाड़ी चलाना जानते हैं। उस रात बहुत बुरा लगा था, पर गुस्सा नहीं किया, सीखने का डिसाइड किया। [Sir, three months ago you told me in front of everyone that ambulance people only know how to drive. I felt very bad that night, but I didn't get angry, I decided to learn.] Speaker B: कैसे सीखा? [How did you learn?] Speaker C: सर, इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड की। जनरल इंग्लिश शो से स्टार्ट किया। 'हेलो' से बात शुरू करें। पहला वीडियो 1,65,000 लोग देख चुके थे। बेसिक इंग्लिश सीखी, फिर मेडिकल टर्म्स खुद प्रैक्टिस किए। [Sir, I downloaded the English Seekho app. Started with the General English Show. 'Start conversation with Hello'. The first video was already watched by 165,000 people. Learnt basic English, then practiced medical terms myself.] Speaker B: मेडिकल इंग्लिश कहाँ से? [Where did you get medical English from?] Speaker C: एआई कोच है सर, 24 घंटे अवेलेबल है। मैंने बोला मुझे पेशेंट हैंडओवर देना है इंग्लिश में, एआई कोच ने सिखा दिया। The patient is an approximately 40-year-old male presenting with no known allergies. Vital signs were recorded at the time of pickup. [There is an AI coach, sir, available 24 hours. I said I want to give a patient handover in English, the AI coach taught me. The patient is an approximately 40-year-old male presenting with no known allergies. Vital signs were recorded at the time of pickup.] Speaker C: एक-एक लाइन प्रैक्टिस की। 500 बार गलत बोला, 500 बार सुधारा। कभी नहीं बोली 'एम्बुलेंस ड्राइवर है, तुझसे नहीं होगा'। [Practiced line by line. Said it wrong 500 times, corrected it 500 times. It never said 'you are an ambulance driver, you can't do it'.] Speaker B: कल का फॉर्म दिखाओ। [Show me yesterday's form.] Speaker C: सर, ये रहा। Chief complaint male, 40 years, road traffic accident, complaint of severe pain in the right leg and abrasion on the forehead. Vitals BP 130/85 mm Hg, SpO2 97%, pulse 92 bpm, allergies non-reported. First aid: wound cleaned, splint applied to right leg, oxygen administered at 2 liters per minute. [Sir, here it is. Chief complaint male, 40 years, road traffic accident, complaint of severe pain in the right leg and abrasion on the forehead. Vitals BP 130/85 mm Hg, SpO2 97%, pulse 92 bpm, allergies non-reported. First aid: wound cleaned, splint applied to right leg, oxygen administered at 2 liters per minute.] Speaker B: ये तूने लिखा है? [Did you write this?] Speaker C: हाँ सर। रोज़ रात को ड्यूटी के बाद एआई कोच से प्रैक्टिस करता हूँ, फॉर्म लिखता हूँ, सुधारती है। हैंडओवर बोलता हूँ, करेक्ट करती है। अब हर पेशेंट का हैंडओवर इंग्लिश में देता हूँ। [Yes sir. Every night after duty I practice with the AI coach, write forms, she corrects them. I speak handovers, she corrects them. Now I give every patient's handover in English.] Speaker B: राजू, आई ओ यू एन अपोलॉजी। [Raju, I owe you an apology.] Speaker C: सर, अपोलॉजी की ज़रूरत नहीं है। बस एक रिक्वेस्ट है, बाकी एम्बुलेंस स्टाफ को भी इंग्लिश सीखने का मौका दो। इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप है, जनरल इंग्लिश शो से स्टार्ट करें। एआई कोच से प्रैक्टिस करें रोज़ 15 मिनट। एक महीने में हैंडओवर इंग्लिश में देंगे, पेशेंट की केयर बेटर होगी और कोई हमें सिर्फ गाड़ी चलाने वाला नहीं बोलेगा। [Sir, no need for an apology. Just one request, give the rest of the ambulance staff a chance to learn English too. There is the English Seekho app, start with the General English Show. Practice with the AI coach for 15 minutes daily. In one month they will give handovers in English, patient care will be better, and no one will call us just drivers.] Speaker D: तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: An ambulance driver is initially mocked by a doctor for his poor English and lack of medical terminology during a patient handover. Motivated by the humiliation, he uses the English Seekho app's AI coach to master professional medical English. The doctor apologizes, and the driver encourages others to download the app to improve their communication skills.
